transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me. Um... I guess what brings me in today is... well, I've just been having this feeling like I can't quite settle in my own body anymore? I mean, it's probably not a huge deal, I know everyone gets a little antsy sometimes, but it's just been making things a bit difficult lately. 

Especially when I'm supposed to just sit quietly and handle, you know, normal, everyday things like paperwork or sitting down to go over shared household plans. I just get so restless and I can't seem to just sit and focus on it. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining that okay.
Did this restless feeling start or worsen after starting or changing any medications recently?

Oh, um, no. I haven't started any new medications or changed anything like that recently. I probably should have mentioned that right away, I'm sorry! But yeah, no new medicines at all. I hope that's helpful? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying about many different everyday things, to the point that it feels hard to control?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I worry a normal amount, I guess? Like anyone would about everyday household things. But it doesn't feel hard to control or anything like that. It's really just that physical restlessness and not being able to settle down to focus, rather than being anxious in my head. Does that make sense? I hope I'm not complicating things by saying no to that one! I just want to be as accurate for you as possible.

I hope that's a good thing! Am I answering your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to know.

Oh, um... well, I really try hard to be polite and respectful, I promise! I don't ever want to be rude. But... sometimes, I guess I do catch myself jumping into my husband's conversations. Or, you know, if someone is talking, I might accidentally finish their thought for them? It's just that the response pops into my head and comes right out before I can remind myself to wait my turn. 

It's not that I'm trying to be pushy, I swear! It just slips out. Is that... is that the kind of thing you're asking about? I hope it doesn't make me sound like a terrible listener! I really do try my best.
